name: Reclaim.ai
description: Reclaim.ai is an intelligent calendar assistant that automatically schedules tasks, habits, focus time, breaks, and meetings around a person's real availability. Individuals and teams use it to protect priorities, coordinate schedules, share booking links, and keep plans current as calendars change.
agentUseSummary: Add your Reclaim.ai API key once, then select which agents can read schedules or manage the supported Reclaim planning actions under Safe or Dangerous policy.

credentialRequirements.name: RECLAIM_AI_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Reclaim.ai API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: In Reclaim, open Settings > Developer, generate an API key, and copy it when Reclaim shows it.

capabilities.label: Read Reclaim schedules
capabilities.description: Read the authorized user, calendar events, tasks, smart habits, time policies, scheduling links, and scheduling-link groups.

capabilities.label: Manage Reclaim schedules
capabilities.description: Create and update tasks, start or stop task and habit sessions, add time, complete or reopen work, snooze tasks, interpret quick plans, and create one-off scheduling links.

allowed.label: Read Reclaim.ai
allowed.description: Read one exact bounded endpoint used by Reclaim's supported Raycast integration.

approvalRequired.label: Manage Reclaim.ai
approvalRequired.description: Call one exact bounded supported scheduling mutation; Safe mode requires approval.

blocked.label: Expose the API key
blocked.description: The API key remains encrypted and never enters agent-visible requests, URLs, or results.

blocked.label: Use another origin
blocked.description: Every request is pinned to Reclaim's public API origin used by its supported Raycast integration.

blocked.label: Call another endpoint
blocked.description: Relay permits only the exact Reclaim routes currently exercised by the supported Raycast integration.

blocked.label: Run an unbounded transfer
blocked.description: Relay bounds paths, queries, bodies, redirects, results, nesting, and execution time.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded reads run directly. Every task, habit, planner, interpreter, or one-off-link mutation requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Every selected key-authorized Reclaim operation runs without Relay per-action approval. Connection ownership, provider authority, exact endpoints, request bounds, credential protection, provider limits, and audits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts separate exact-endpoint read and manage tools and injects the encrypted API key only at Reclaim's fixed public API origin.
Relay mounts separate exact-endpoint read and manage tools and injects the encrypted API key only at Reclaim's fixed public API origin.

providerSetup.blocker: Reclaim's supported Raycast and Zapier integrations use a customer-generated bearer API key; Reclaim does not document a third-party OAuth app flow that Relay can own.
providerSetup.nextAction: Generate a Reclaim API key in Settings > Developer, connect it in Relay Console, then verify representative reads, Safe mutation approval, Dangerous schedule management, redaction, key rotation, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Reclaim describes itself as an intelligent calendar assistant that optimizes schedules around work and life priorities.
Reclaim instructs users to generate an API key for its supported Raycast integration and documents calendar, task, habit, and scheduling-link features.
Reclaim's Zapier connection also uses a customer-generated API key and supports creating automatically scheduled Reclaim tasks.
The current Raycast Store source pins bearer-key requests to api.app.reclaim.ai/api and defines the exact supported read and scheduling-action routes Relay exposes.
